paragraphs.text: Lemur is a creature type for cards that depict small, wet-nosed primates.

Only 3 lemurs have been printed so far, all of which have been mono- white . However, all of these cards represent the same character ( Momo ). As such, it is unclear if white should be considered the standard color for the type in general.
Lemur debuted as a type in the Universes Beyond set Avatar: The Last Airbender to represent Momo a winged lemur, whose cards are typed as Lemur Bats due to being lemurs with bat-like wings.

While the type hasn't been used outside of the Avatar set, lemurs have been depicted in the art of several cards. The first depiction of a lemur was for Hyalopterous Lemure in Ice Age . The card was originally meant to be a lemure - a type of shade or spirit of the restless or malignant dead. However, in a misunderstanding, the artist Richard Thomas thought it was referring to the animal. As this was early in Magic design there was not a team to double-check the art and it slipped through. This led the original art to be of a small furry winged creature, while later art depicts it as a malevolent spirit of energy. The name, text, and flavor text on Viscid Lemures were later created to reference this.
Lemurs also appear in the art of Surgeon General Commander , which features a lemur's head, and Preposterous Proportions , which features a giant lemur in its borderless art.
